_about: Made-up replies of the program tagger for the made-up CodeVision folder (home only). One per module.

src/layouts/limits_screen.py.summary: Shows the made-up limits screen with expiry dates.

src/agents/limits_batch.py.summary: Runs the made-up expiry report for a list of customers.

src/agents/limits_expiry_report.py.summary: Builds one report line per customer limit and counts days left.

src/agents/docs_markdown_export.py.summary: Creates a Markdown file with a heading and one bullet per line.

src/agents/docs_folder_to_md.py.summary: Creates one Markdown file for each text note in a folder.
